platform_export_limitations.description: Vertex AI Memory Bank (Agent Platform) does not currently provide a bulk table-dump API for cross-project migration. Memories are created asynchronously from conversation sessions via Vertex AI Agent Engine background workers.
platform_export_limitations.migration_strategy: When recreating in a new Google Cloud project: (1) Provision a new Memory Bank using Vertex AI Agent Engine / ADK CLI (`agents-cli` or `agentplatform.Client().memory_banks.create()`). (2) Configure MEMORY_BANK_ID in .env. (3) Re-seed durable organizer preferences into sessions or pre-seed via `add_memory`.
